mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO a WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT a.USER_ID FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO a WHERE a.USER_NM = #{userNm} ORDER BY a.CREATE_DT
SELECT a.USER_PW FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO a WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(a.STATE_CD, '') <> 'D'

SELECT b.REVIEW_ID ,b.REVIEW_TITLE ,b.REVIEW_CONTENT ,b.REVIEW_CONTENT_EN ,b.REVIEW_CONTENT_JA ,b.REVIEW_CONTENT_KO ,b.REVIEW_SCORE ,c.USER_NM ,c.PROFILE_IMG_URL ,b.IMG_URLS ,b.CREATE_DT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW b LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a ON a.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO c ON b.CREATE_USER = c.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND b.USE_YN = 'Y' AND b.REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'O'
AND (a.CREATE_USER = #{userId} OR b.CREATE_USER = #{userId})
ORDER BY b.REVIEW_SCORE DESC, b.CREATE_DT DESC ORDER BY b.CREATE_DT DESC
LIMIT 10
OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_USER_LANGUAGE (USER_ID, LANG_CD, LEVEL_CD, SORT_ORDER) VALUES (#{userId}, #{langCd}, #{levelCd}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT a.LANG_CD ,b.CMM_CM_NM AS LANG_NM ,a.LEVEL_CD AS LEVEL_NM FROM TB_TRMA_USER_LANGUAGE a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b ON a.LANG_CD = b.CMM_CDV AND b.CMM_CD_ID = 'LANG_CD' WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY a.SORT_ORDER

SELECT m.MOIM_TITLE FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST m WHERE m.CREATE_USER = #{userId} AND m.USE_YN = 'Y' AND m.MOIM_END_DT >= CURDATE() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER mm WHERE mm.MOIM_ID = m.MOIM_ID AND mm.USER_ID <> #{userId} AND mm.STATE_CD = 'Y') ORDER BY m.MOIM_START_DT
SELECT m.MOIM_ID FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST m WHERE m.CREATE_USER = #{userId} AND m.USE_YN = 'Y' AND m.MOIM_END_DT >= CURDATE()
mapper.delete: DELETE mm FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER mm JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST m ON m.MOIM_ID = mm.MOIM_ID WHERE mm.USER_ID = #{userId} AND m.MOIM_END_DT >= CURDATE()
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_TRMA_USER_INFO SET USER_NM = '탈퇴한 회원' ,USER_PW = #{userPw} ,PHONE_NUM = '' ,GENDER_CD = '' ,BIRTH_DT = '1900-01-01' ,PROFILE_IMG_URL = NULL ,AREA_NM = NULL ,AREA_NM_EN = NULL ,AREA_NM_JA = NULL ,AREA_NM_KO = NULL ,DESCRIPTION = NULL ,DESCRIPTION_EN = NULL ,DESCRIPTION_JA = NULL ,DESCRIPTION_KO = NULL ,STATE_CD = 'D' ,UPDATE_USER = #{userId} ,UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(STATE_CD, '') <> 'D'
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO WHERE STATE_CD = 'D'

SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NM AS userNm, u.STATE_CD AS stateCd, DATE_FORMAT(u.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST m WHERE m.CREATE_USER = u.USER_ID AND m.USE_YN = 'Y') AS ownedMoimCnt, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER mm WHERE mm.USER_ID = u.USER_ID) AS memberRowCnt FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO u WHERE u.USER_ID LIKE 'e2e+%@tripmate.test' ORDER BY u.CREATE_DT
